verdict.rationale: Featurebase's automatic notification of 'all relevant users when their requests are shipped' implies that feedback requests are tied to the users who submitted or voted on them. The feedback portal and in-app widgets capture submissions, and the Posts API exposes feedback submissions. However, no evidence explicitly describes linking an individual feedback item to a specific customer or company record. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of submitter/customer attribution on feedback posts, ability to attach feedback on behalf of a customer, customer/company profile linkage, independent corroboration.
